common.command.capture_limit: communicate architecture is unchanged. cap is checked after collection, not during reads; while-read memory/pipe-emission bounds are not repaired or proved.

coverage_exit.None_means: No actual exit retained; complete_os_exit_status is false. Never fabricated reap.

common.command.failure: Original first BaseException is retained before cleanup and finish; cap/nonzero command failures are latched before finish. Outer io_until restoration errors do not replace an earlier failure.
common.command.secondary_errors: Existing COVERAGE_ERRORS only: at most 32 entries, each at most 2048 characters. No new writer or output file.
common.command.success: Original stdout bytes; actual returncode must equal 0 and original cap must pass.

port_diagnostic.query.capture_limit: Original nonblocking stream capture and byte accounting remain. OS stalls, parser latency, emitted-but-unread data and full while-read timing guarantees remain unproved.
port_diagnostic.query.cause: UNKNOWN always. Neither rows nor syscall return reclassify the original EADDRINUSE.
port_diagnostic.query.errors: Original ordered finite query/owned-helper-reap/pipe-close list. Query error is appended before cleanup. Cleanup errors do not remove prior entries.

kill_eligibility_exit.meaning: Actual poll return, stored before clock sample. None never proves reap.

kill_eligibility_monotonic.meaning: Immediate same-process post-poll sample; null if no sample returned. It is not the poll or syscall completion time.

kill_eligibility_observed.meaning: True only after the actual retained-child poll returned. Distinguishes no poll from a poll returning None.

kill_requested.meaning: Existing pre-call attempt flag. It alone proves neither syscall entry nor return.

kill_requested_monotonic.meaning: Same actual eligibility sample, reused without another clock call; no invented syscall timestamp.

kill_returned.meaning: Existing legacy field: true only after the direct os.kill syscall returned successfully. No delivery, termination, reap or EOF claim.

reaped.meaning: True only for non-None actual poll/wait status; actual codes stay signed even if the next clock fails or is late.

reaped_monotonic.meaning: A later observation sample; missing timestamps are not invented.
reaped_monotonic.presence: Only when original post-wait sample returns

port_diagnostic.query.status: Existing COLLECTED_CONTEXT_ONLY predicate is unchanged; any unknown/unreaped result, timeout, error or incomplete output is INCOMPLETE.
port_diagnostic.query.timed_out: Existing flag; true on DeadlineError or TimeoutExpired, including a post-poll sample at or after the original helper end.

Controller.port_unchanged.acceptance: Diagnostics cannot accept the failed flow. No bind retry, SO_REUSE, alternate port, product signal or added helper observation.
Controller.port_unchanged.deadline: query_deadline=min(original port deadline - 0.05, current monotonic + 0.5). Original 80/20 diagnostic read/cleanup partition remains.
Controller.port_unchanged.first_failure: Original FAILED bind is latched before diagnostic/publication and remains first.
Controller.port_unchanged.query: One post-EADDRINUSE /usr/sbin/netstat -AanW -p tcp query; no added prequery. Original pre-bind command is unchanged.

accounting_unchanged.rules: Existing regular R9 accounting, precharge, file/count/round limits, exclusive first publication and reserve rules remain. Diagnostic publication uses regular capacity only. Coverage gaps remain UNVERIFIED.

signal_contract.eligibility: Actual fresh code is None AND sample < ORIGINAL absolute deadline. No Popen.kill/send_signal wrapper, PID lookup or OS query intervenes.
signal_contract.late_or_clock_failure: Keep any actual signed code already observed. Skip signal if no fresh eligible sample. Late None keeps unknown/unreaped failure and grants no new wait.
signal_contract.ordering: Actual poll -> retain real signed code/reap if present -> immediate same-process monotonic sample -> in-memory predicates/flags only -> at most one direct os.kill(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL).
signal_contract.ownership_precondition: Parent retains the original Popen and is the sole reaper. No concurrent waiter, other waitpid caller, SIGCHLD discard or external reaper may reap this child. Unreaped direct-child identity cannot be reused under this contract.
signal_contract.reaping: Only original remaining(deadline) may feed existing communicate/wait. Syscall exception cannot imply reap or grant a new allowance. Unknown fails acceptance.
signal_contract.scope: Only the exact retained read-only helper in its original failure/cleanup branch. No new product, foreign or group authority.
signal_contract.scope_limit: Clock sampling, OS polling, signal syscalls, I/O and scheduling can stall. Source ordering is not hard preemption, signal delivery, termination or runtime proof.
